No one averaged 26 and 9 while making it look that easy.

Rightfully enshrined. 🏆

stories.title: Stephen Curry Extension — 11 Days to August 29 Window

x_posts.label: Post 3
x_posts.text:
11 days.

Stephen Curry can sign a 2-year, $136.7M max extension on August 29.

GM Dunleavy: "Pretty confident Steph will finish his career" as a Warrior.

But the Warriors went 37-45 last year. Curry wants to WIN.

Aug 29 tells us everything.

#Warriors #NBA

research.facts:
Kawhi Leonard Toronto Trade Pending
**Sources:** Yahoo Sports, ClutchPoints, NBA.com, Sofascore
**Key Facts:**
- Trade agreed: June 29-30, 2026 [HIGH]
- Deal: Leonard to Toronto Raptors for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, unprotected first-round picks in 2031 and 2033, a 2027 first-round swap, and two second-round picks [HIGH]
- Trade on hold: NBA investigation into alleged salary cap circumvention [HIGH]
- Allegation: Clippers funneled money to Leonard through now-bankrupt company Aspiration ($28M) [HIGH]
- Second deal under scrutiny: Daktronics (scoreboard manufacturer at Intuit Dome) [HIGH]
- Resolution expected: approximately 6 weeks after Aug 10 = ~September 22, 2026 [MEDIUM]
- Leonard's comment: expects trade to clear before camp [MEDIUM]
- Extension timeline: once trade is official, Leonard eligible for 2-year extension worth ~$123.7M [HIGH]
- Return to LA: Nov. 2, 2026 (Kawhi plays at former team) [HIGH]
- Toronto training camp: September 28-29, Quebec City [HIGH]
